narrative: The tall stone oriel and dark timber gatehouse of Crosby Place seen from the corner of Great St Helen's lane at dusk on the evening of the new moon: one high mullioned window lit with yellow candlelight in the stone bay above, a link-boy's pitch torch smoking in the iron cresset by the shut gate below, the cobbles wet and dark. No hand and no face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked once from the corner and went on into the close.

entities.name: Crosby Place
